settings.name: DATABASE_URI
settings.description: **Database URI:** The primary database connection string in the SQLAlchemy format.

settings.name: DATABASE_URI_READONLY
settings.description: **Read-Only Database URI:** Optional database for read-only operations or as a failover if the main database is down.

settings.name: DATABASE_LOG_LEVEL
settings.description: **Log Level:** The verbosity level for database logs. Options: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `warning`, or `error`.

settings.name: DATABASE_MAX_JOBS_RUNS
settings.description: **Maximum Job Runs:** The maximum number of job execution records to retain in the database before automatic cleanup.

settings.name: DATABASE_MAX_SESSION_AGE_DAYS
settings.description: **Session Retention:** The maximum age (in days) for UI user sessions before they are purged automatically. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is days.

settings.name: DATABASE_POOL_SIZE
settings.description: **Pool Size:** The number of connections to keep in the database connection pool.

settings.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX_OVERFLOW
settings.description: **Pool Max Overflow:** The maximum number of connections to create above the pool size. Set to `-1` for unlimited overflow.

settings.name: DATABASE_POOL_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Pool Timeout:** The number of seconds to wait before giving up on getting a connection from the pool. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: DATABASE_POOL_RECYCLE
settings.description: **Pool Recycle:** The number of seconds after which a connection is automatically recycled. Set to `-1` to disable. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: DATABASE_POOL_PRE_PING
settings.description: **Pool Pre-Ping:** Whether to test connections for liveness upon each checkout from the pool.

settings.name: DATABASE_POOL_RESET_ON_RETURN
settings.description: **Pool Reset on Return:** How connections are reset when returned to the pool. Empty for auto (`none` for MySQL/MariaDB, `rollback` for others). Options: `rollback`, `commit`, `none`.

settings.name: DATABASE_RETRY_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Retry Timeout:** The maximum number of seconds to wait for the database to be available on startup. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: DATABASE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Connect Timeout:** The maximum time to wait when opening a connection to a MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL server. It must be greater than `0`: the drivers cannot run without one, and `0` falls back to the default with a warning. A timeout set in the `DATABASE_URI` query string takes precedence. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: DATABASE_READ_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Read Timeout:** The maximum time to wait for a MySQL or MariaDB server to answer or accept data before the call fails, so a vanished peer cannot block forever. PostgreSQL relies on TCP keepalives instead. `0` disables it. A timeout set in the `DATABASE_URI` query string takes precedence. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: DATABASE_REQUEST_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
settings.description: **Request Retry Attempts:** The number of retry attempts for transient database errors during operations.

settings.name: DATABASE_REQUEST_RETRY_DELAY
settings.description: **Request Retry Delay:** The delay in seconds between retry attempts for transient database errors. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.
